title: Choose the collection layout
question: Category browsing will lead and copy will stay quiet. Which arrangement feels right for Vee?

options.label: Category chapters
options.thesis: The whole collection unfolds as a sequence of category galleries.
options.viewport: A quiet title and category directory lead into the first open product grid; every category follows down the page.
options.risk: Longer scrolling as the catalog grows; a sticky category directory keeps orientation.

options.label: Category directory
options.thesis: A permanent category index sits beside one focused product gallery.
options.viewport: The left column lists categories and counts; the right changes to the selected category's product grid.
options.risk: It is highly scannable but gives less sense of the complete collection at once.

options.label: Focused category
options.thesis: One category at a time receives an expansive, editorial product display.
options.viewport: Large category name and selected product image lead; compact category controls reveal other products without a long scroll.
options.risk: The emphasis can feel sparse while Vee has only a few catalog items.
